rows.en: Dr. Deviler, the Leader of the Iron Mask Party, wanted Father's outstanding robot technology… But Father refused him!

Damn it… Iron Mask Party, I won't forgive them!

But why? How did you get captured by that Iron Mask Party and still make it back safely, Brother?
That's…
Ah!? That's the Trojan Horse!
Now, Ken! Have the lever memorize your fingerprints!
My fingerprints?

The electronic brain memorizes the fingerprints of the first person to grip the lever.

After that, the lever won't work for anyone but you!

Now… grip it, Ken! Defeat the Trojan Horse!
All right… Main lever, auto! Fight lever, on!!

Ugh… damn it! I have to exchange my brain's blood for fresh blood! Ngh, after coming this far…

Kikaider! And Zero-One! The next time we meet… I'll take your lives, without fail!
Oh no! Hakaider is…!! Dr. Komyoji!!
Oh no! Hakaider is…!! Dr. Komyoji!!
Kikaider!! Pathetic! Is that all your power amounts to!?
Ken! Hang in there! Ken!!
Nngh… You'll pay for this!!
I am immortal! Remember that well!!
We did it! We did it, Brother!
Yes… Well done, Ken!
Gwah… ugh…

Its performance is even more splendid than expected…

Good work, Kenichiro Kurenai! Now bring Red Baron to me at once!
Ugh… No! I don't want to give it to you!
Brother, what's wrong?
Kenichiro Kurenai… You are our mecha-human. If you defy us, you will die…
Nooooooo!!
What's wrong, Brother? Are you all right? Brother!!
Ken… I'm counting on you to look after Red Baron!
Don't lose to the Iron Mask Party! Don't you dare lose!
What's wrong… You're acting strange all of a sudden, Brother.
They turned me into a mecha-human…
A mecha-human?
Brother, where are you going? Wait, Brother!!
Heh heh heh… Ken Kurenai!
You!? Who are you?
I am Deviler, Leader of the robot empire, the Iron Mask Party!
You're Dr. Deviler!? What did you do to my brother!!
Heh heh heh… Watch closely as the traitor meets his end!
Brotheeeer!!

In response to the Iron Mask Party joining the fight with its giant robots, the TDF entrusted the heroes with units from its support organization, UCMA, the International Crisis Management Military Alliance.
By special order of the SSI, both Ken Kurenai and Mari Matsubara would also fight alongside the heroes.
Resolved to defeat the hateful Iron Mask Party, which targeted Earth and drove his brother to blow himself up, Ken's eyes burned crimson, true to his name…

Father, Mother, Brother, Kenzo…

I'll smash the Iron Mask Party with my own hands, I swear it! I swear! Watch me!!
Defeat all of the DARK Destruction Squad and rescue Dr. Kenichiro Kurenai!
Defeat all of the DARK Destruction Squad and rescue Dr. Kenichiro Kurenai! Also, capture the laboratory and the factory!
Defeat all of the DARK Destruction Squad and destroy the Trojan Horse! Also, capture the laboratory and the factory!
Mari Matsubara is defeated
All allies are destroyed
Jiro is defeated, or Hakaider is destroyed
Jiro or Ken Kurenai is defeated, or Hakaider is destroyed
Ken Kurenai is defeated
A leading authority in cytology, he discovered the parasitic cell Vol in the corpse of a mysterious creature washed up on the shore…
Vol parasitizes any kind of living thing, multiplying again and again and remaking its host's body tissue into something tougher than that of any creature on Earth…
Bewitched by Vol, he implanted those demonic cells into his family and his lab staff and began his experiments.
The Vol experiments seemed to go smoothly for a time, but in the dead of night in their third year, they came to a sudden end!
The test subject that ran out of control… EATER, the name it shared with the project, was his son, Satoru…
His research facility and the other test subjects vanished into the flames along with Satoru!
The next day, a seriously injured girl and a miraculously unharmed boy were found in the burned ruins of the laboratory…
And from the lab data that survived the fire, it was revealed that the two were subjects of a certain experiment. That experiment's project name was EATER…
[HERO2]… Do you know who I am?
You're… Why are you crying? Ugh… My head, my head feels like it's splitting…
It's okay, [HERO2]… Don't be scared… I'm right here with you.
Ugh… Who… who am I…?
So… the two of them are still out at [HERO4]'s home in the country?
Yes… At [HERO4]'s family home, where her grandfather lives… We thought he, if anyone, might…

Damn… Why did this have to happen…

And so suddenly too… He's going to be all right, isn't he? [HERO2], I mean?
Yes… It bothered me, so I looked into it myself! Into these archaeal cells…
…!? It's Shocker! Let's go, [HERO4]!
We did it, [HERO2]!

Yeah…

But is there a Shocker secret base around here too?
Wherever you go in Japan… huh?

…!?

Wh-what the!?
Surprised you?
What's with that ringtone?

It's our theme song.

Cool, right? Want me to put it on your phone too, [HERO2]?
You… sure have a lot of free time, huh?
It's easy, it only takes a sec…

Hmm…

Come to think of it… with all these days of nothing but fighting, it feels like it's been a while since I talked with you like this…

That's right…

I'm always with you, [HERO2], and I'm having fun in my own way… but [HERO2], you never talk to me about anything.

Really…?

But hey, didn't you put on a little weight lately?
Th-that's not true! I haven't changed one bit from before. You're the one who put on weight, [HERO2]!

Yeah… Being around you will do that… Stress weight, I guess?

More importantly, isn't that your phone?
